implementation_choices.base_hash_check: SHA256 over sorted frozen base state_dict tensors before and after both residual trainings
implementation_choices.residual_application: one 4-feature context vector -> one vocab residual vector, broadcast identically across all 24 next-token positions in that context
implementation_choices.residual_training_objective: cross_entropy over all 24 target positions per registered training context
implementation_choices.residual_training_steps: exactly the same 120 context starts used to train the base model
implementation_choices.shuffle_rule: sort source context indices by SHA256(namespace|seed|split|context_index); output position k receives feature vector from sorted source index k
implementation_choices.structural_alignment: relation features computed from cleaned raw tokens at the exact encoded input-context positions; decoded <unk> tokens are not substituted into the structural channel
implementation_choices.validation_window_rule: 16 unique rounded equally-spaced starts round(i*vmax/15), i=0..15; fail closed unless exactly 16 unique windows
implementation_choices.zero_init_check: exact torch.equal on every real and shuffled validation feature vector before residual training
implementation_choices.zero_structural_post_training_check: exact torch.equal for both trained real and shuffled residuals on every validation base-logit tensor
